what_happened: The job to give OLY-B-O5-01 a mechanism (athena restart and status restarts) was rejected at the final verdict. One of 5 acceptance criteria was unmet: running cargo fmt --check, clippy --all-targets and cargo test, all passing. The test check failed separately: shard 1 of 6 reported 1 of 12 units failed (athena-core --lib), and the kept output shows only passing tests, so the failing assertion is not visible. The verifier gave one blocker and three majors. Blocker: the measure label `restarts` is not an accepted status measure label (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in status.rs, measure_problem in hestia.rs), so the real-spec test fails and the spec gap remains. Majors: behavior criterion 4's evidence must cite commands that ran (D43); the new lifecycle test also passes on the base tree because restart and status code already existed; the reading does not match the request.
cause: Nothing cross-checked the accepted reading against the request's wording, or the new spec measure against what the code accepts, before the final verdict. The measure label `restarts` was written into docs/spec.toml without checking it against the accepted label list that the real-spec test enforces. Nothing required a new test to fail on the base tree, so a test of code that already existed passed as proof. The producer's behavior evidence was not tied to commands that ran (D43). Because the reading misstated the request, the criteria could pass without showing the request was met.
other_causes: The test failure in athena-core --lib (shard 1) was not caught by the producer running the existing tests before it finished.
Nothing required the producer to confirm that the capability (restart, status restarts) was missing before designing a mechanism for it.
open_hypotheses: The athena-core --lib unit that failed is probably the real-spec test rejecting the `restarts` label, but the kept output shows only passing tests, so this cannot be confirmed.
Whether the code already satisfied the request, so that the true gap was only the spec measure, cannot be told from the given fields.
contradictions: The failed-check output shows only passing tests and a shard summary, so it does not name the failing test; the link to the blocker finding is inferred, not shown.
prevention: Add a code check that runs before the verifier, at reading acceptance and again after the producer finishes. It would (1) validate every measure label a job adds or edits in docs/spec.toml against STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS by running the real-spec test; (2) require each new behavior test to fail on the base tree, and record that run; (3) require each behavior criterion's evidence to cite commands that ran (D43); (4) compare the accepted reading with the request's wording. These catch the whole class of readings and provenance that disagree with the request or the code, before the final verdict.
proposed_request: Give OLY-B-O5-01 (athena restart and status restarts) a working mechanism. First check what the code already does for restart and status, and say which part of the spec gap remains. In docs/spec.toml use a measure label that STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS accepts, or add `restarts` to that list with its status output and a test. Add a test that fails on the base tree and passes after the change. Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test, including the real-spec test in athena-core, and cite those commands as evidence. Add the CHANGELOG.md entry.
